description: Deterministic OW-011 gate fixture: a Claude-plugin-shaped hooks.json with unconditional PreToolUse/PostToolUse handlers. No matcher is set on either handler on purpose: the gate measured that OpenCode's and Kilo's real tool.execute.before/after ctx uses different key names than Claude's tool_name/tool_input shape, so a matcher would silently never match on a live host (see the script's own notes). Each handler appends a distinguishing sentinel line to a proof file named by AGENTSYNC_E2E_PROOF_DIR, which the gate script exports before every host invocation, and then emits a small, allowed JSON field so the shim's output translation has something real to carry.
